title: Go JOSE: Panic during CBC-HMAC processing
description: A vulnerability identified as CVE-2026-116585 affects version 3.0 of a Microsoft product related to Go JOSE, causing a panic during CBC-HMAC processing. The issue is categorized under CWE-129, indicating an improper validation of array index or similar error. No CVSS score or detailed impact information is provided, and no patch or remediation details are available.
